synth.notes:
Floor = colour 5, walls = any other colour, read straight from the frame (the maze is visible in this variant).
Blocks (4x4, colour 10): A1/A2 move both up/down by 4; A3/A4 mirror horizontally (left block dx, right block -dx). Each block moves only if its target 4x4 is all floor.
Clicking an inactive marker (9) arms: blocks turn colour 1 and that marker turns 11. Clicking another marker switches; clicking a player disarms; any other click does nothing.
While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker 4 cells if its 4x4 cell (marker x,y minus 1) is all floor.
HUD: colour-0 bars on row 0 (from right) and row 63 (from left), width = 3(a+1)//7 where a counts actions. a is carried only while each input frame matches the last output; otherwise a = 0 if no bar, else the largest a for that width. A7 never observed.
